answer: Yes, we buy cars registered in any state we serve, even if you now live in a different one, so you can sell your Virginia-registered car at a North Carolina store. At a North Carolina store, a car registered in another state needs an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station before we can buy it. Bring your Virginia registration, and since Virginia plates are removed and kept, take them off the car. North Carolina normally requires the registration to be current on the day of the sale, but the help center doesn't say exactly how that applies to an expired out-of-state registration like yours, so please contact the store to confirm before your appointment.

facts.fact: renew the registration before the appointment, because in North Carolina it must be current on the day of the sale
get an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station
